LanguageData.MST.stackLimitComment: The stack limit for this item.
LanguageData.MST.stackedEffectMultiplierComment: The multiplicative multiplier for stacked effects of this thought.
LanguageData.MST.durationDaysComment: The duration of this thought in days.
LanguageData.MST.stackLimitForSameOtherPawnComment: The maximum number of this thought type allowed for the same "target" thought. -1 means unlimited.
LanguageData.MST.lerpMoodToZeroComment: Whether the mood effect of this thought decreases over time.
LanguageData.MST.stagesStackComment: Allow thoughts of the same def at different stages to stack together. If false, only instances in the same stage merge.
LanguageData.MST.invertComment: Invert the worker condition: the thought becomes active when the condition is NOT met (at stage 0).
LanguageData.MST.validWhileDespawnedComment: The memory stays valid while its pawn is despawned.
LanguageData.MST.nullifiedIfNotColonistComment: The thought is nullified if the pawn is not a colonist.
LanguageData.MST.showBubbleComment: Show a mood thought bubble when this memory is gained.
LanguageData.MST.ignoreSubhumansComment: Do not apply this situational thought to subhuman pawns.
LanguageData.MST.doNotApplyToQuestLodgersComment: Do not apply this thought to quest lodgers.
LanguageData.MST.lerpOpinionToZeroAfterDurationPctCom: For social thoughts: after this percentage of the duration has passed, the opinion offset lerps back to zero.
LanguageData.MST.maxCumulatedOpinionOffsetComment: Maximum accumulated opinion offset from stacked instances of this social thought.
LanguageData.MST.requiredTraitsDegreeComment: Required degree for requiredTraits. Leave empty for any degree.
LanguageData.MST.socialTargetDevelopmentalStageFilter: Which developmental stages the social target must be. Newborn/Baby/Child/Adult.
LanguageData.MST.nextThoughtComment: Memory that replaces this one when it expires (memories only, cannot be combined with workerClass).
LanguageData.MST.producesMemoryThoughtComment: Memory thought produced when this situational thought is active.
LanguageData.MST.thoughtToMakeComment: Another thought the pawn also gains (chained) when gaining this memory, targeting the same pawn.
LanguageData.MST.mentalStateComment: The thought is active while the pawn is in this mental state (with a ThoughtWorker_MentalState-based worker).
LanguageData.MST.gameConditionComment: The thought only applies while this game condition is active.
LanguageData.MST.effectMultiplyingStatComment: A stat on the pawn that multiplies this thought's effect.
LanguageData.MST.effectMultiplyingStatCurveComment: Curve mapping the effectMultiplyingStat value to the effect multiplier.
LanguageData.MST.minExpectationComment: The pawn's colony expectation must be at least this level for the thought to apply.
LanguageData.MST.minExpectationForNegativeThoughtComm: Minimum colony expectation level for negative thoughts to apply.
LanguageData.MST.chemicalDefComment: Only applies to pawns with an addiction/need for this chemical.
LanguageData.MST.taleDefComment: The tale this memory is associated with.
LanguageData.MST.replaceThoughtsComment: Gaining this memory removes existing memories of these defs.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingTraitsComment: Pawns with any of these traits never get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingTraitDegreesComment: Pawns with any of these traits (at the specified degree, empty = any degree) never get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.neverNullifyIfAnyTraitComment: If the pawn has any of these traits, other nullifying conditions never nullify this thought.
LanguageData.MST.requiredTraitsComment: The pawn must have one of these traits to get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingGenesComment: Pawns with any of these genes never get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.requiredGenesComment: The pawn must have one of these genes to get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingHediffsComment: Pawns with any of these hediffs never get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.requiredHediffsComment: The pawn must have one of these hediffs to get this thought.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingPreceptsComment: Nullified if the pawn's ideology has any of these precepts.
LanguageData.MST.nullifyingOwnTalesComment: Nullified if the pawn is a subject of any of these tales.
